original.indicated: after a race refusal the rerun is --continue, which redoes the snapshot, overlap check and race check against the resolved worktree HEAD and lands

issue.why_categorical: a re-snapshot makes the land diff run from the new target HEAD
issue.why_free_form: the resolved tree is built on the old target_head; a diff from the new target HEAD to it deletes or reverts whatever the late target commit added, so the land would undo target work

new_outcome.indicated: D4: --continue with no rebase in progress sets patch_base to the target_head the finished rebase went onto and reruns the flow from the snapshot against the current target HEAD (a clean trial lands; a conflict stops again)

why_new_outcome.free_form: measuring from the old target_head carries only the worktree's work onto the moved target; test_a_target_that_moves_during_resolution_refuses_then_continue_lands pins it
